acquirer: International Business Machines Corporation (IBM), through its wholly owned merger subsidiary Corvo Merger Sub, Inc.
consideration_type: Cash, subject to limited exceptions including shares for which appraisal rights are properly exercised.
cash_consideration: USD $31.00 in cash per share of Confluent, Inc. Class A common stock, without interest and subject to applicable withholding taxes, except for canceled shares, dissenting shares and subsidiary-converted shares; subject to adjustment for specified changes in outstanding shares before the effective time.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration for eligible Confluent, Inc. Class A common stock.
shareholder_vote_date: Confluent, Inc. stockholders’ special meeting scheduled for 2/12/2026 at 9:00 a.m., Pacific Time.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver on or before closing: adoption of the merger agreement by Confluent stockholders; expiration or termination of the HSR Act waiting period and receipt, termination or expiration, as applicable, of specified non-U.S. antitrust or foreign-investment approvals or waiting periods, without a burdensome condition for IBM and Sub unless IBM waives that requirement; absence of specified legal restraints and pending governmental proceedings seeking to prohibit the merger or impose a legal restraint; Confluent’s representations and warranties being true and correct under the agreement’s applicable materiality standards, its material compliance with required covenants, no continuing material adverse effect since the agreement date, and delivery of its officer’s certificate; IBM’s and Sub’s representations and warranties being true and correct under the agreement’s stated standard, their material compliance with required covenants, and delivery of IBM’s officer’s certificate. There is no financing condition.
event_status: Pending proposed merger; the filing solicits Confluent stockholder approval and describes regulatory clearances as required before completion.
security_description: Confluent, Inc. Class A common stock, par value $0.00001 per share.
effective_date: Not specified. The merger will become effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later date and time agreed by IBM and Confluent and specified in that certificate.
available_options: No holder election for merger consideration; eligible shares convert into the right to receive cash. Qualifying holders who do not vote in favor and satisfy Delaware statutory requirements may instead seek appraisal.
